## Expected and actual behavior

Describe the search or deployment problem without real credentials or private
library/catalog data. Include an invented example when possible.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest steps needed to reproduce the issue.

## Environment

Adapter commit/image, ABS version, Docker/Compose versions and access layout
(localhost, shared Docker network or private LAN).

## Sanitized output

Include adapter HTTP status/error code and relevant log lines. Remove keys,
Authorization headers, private addresses and account information.
